_comment: Claude Code MCP config. Place at your project root as .mcp.json. Keys are read from your environment via ${VAR} (load your .env before launching: set -a; source .env; set +a). Remove any server you are not using.

notion._comment: Self-hosted Notion MCP. Prefer the hosted OAuth one? Delete this block and run: claude mcp add --transport http notion https://mcp.notion.com/mcp

filesystem._comment: Lets the agent read your definitions/ files. Replace the path with your project's absolute path.

tavily._comment: OPTIONAL dedicated web search. You can delete this and rely on Claude Code's built-in WebSearch tool instead.
